_comment: Single structured source of K1 device identity for k1_upload_guard.py. Identity-by-USB-serial GOVERNS; advisory_port is operator convenience only and never overrides the serial check. Quarantined units are refused on every K1 env. See docs/hardware/device-build-registry.md. Edit here, not in code.

authorized.pinmap: bench IM69D130 PDM CLK=39/DATA=38, RIGHT slot; dual 206-px WS2812B on LED 4/5; ESP MAC AC:A7:04:FC:54:0C (native USB-JTAG CDC; was CH9102 WCH 5B7A114793)
authorized._merge_note_2026_08_12: main's side allowlisted k1_custom here. k1_custom extends k1_bench_im73d_ble, so admitting it would put an IM73D build on confirmed IM69D wiring - the S7 stop rule, and the exact false-authority path Captain correction 2026-08-10 voided. Unit 2's env is k1_unit2_im69d_right. Main's ESP MAC + USB adapter provenance is retained in pinmap above.

quarantined.reason: unknown bench device, not authorized for K1 env upload

blocked_envs.k1_sample_rate_32k_spike: 32 kHz spike is build-only until acquisition-only, AP/VP, calibration, and watchdog gates are explicitly re-opened
blocked_envs.k1_prod_im73d: production IM73D env inherits the k1_hardware production LED GPIO map (6/7); no production-LED-wired (6/7) IM73D unit physically exists yet. A 2026-07-07 misflash onto the 4/5-wired bench darkened both LED channels. Re-blocked 2026-07-08 (restores the b735524 posture; reverses the 46525ed un-block) after the forensic root-cause of the bench audio+LED corruption. Unblock only when a correctly-wired production IM73D unit exists.
blocked_envs.k1_custom: BLOCKED — device nomination outstanding. UPDATED 2026-08-12 (P2.B): k1_custom no longer extends any *im73d* env; it now extends k1_bench_im69d_ble (IM69D + BLE-MIDI parent) with -DK1_CUSTOM_LED_V1 (224/160 RGBIC rig). The first unblock condition (Cursor plan P1.A) is MET. Still BLOCKED because no physical device is nominated for this env and the rig's mic identity has never been receipted — before unblocking: nominate a device, receipt its physical mic + PDM pins (P0.C pattern), verify they match this composition. Unit 2 (0C54FC00) is NOT this env; it is k1_unit2_im69d_right.
